digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler inbound link removal applier
propositions: An inbound removal record for a managed link without peer confirmation should be declined, returning False and logging a warning without writing an UNLINK event
An inbound removal record for a link with a valid peer confirmation should converge normally, removing exactly the specified relation
A local link whose outbound ADD is deduped by an inward same-vendor-type remote link should not be removed by an inbound removal record when no confirmation exists
The confirmation store should be opened once per pass and threaded into unlink operations, with None (unopenable store) restoring pre-change behavior
Backfill-sourced confirmation records should allow removal convergence in the first post-upgrade pass despite lacking initial synchronization proof
The per-pass INFO summary must report the decline count alongside impossible-link skips for operator visibility
